name: sf-sdlc
description: Salesforce delivery lifecycle for Claude Code: BRD, Jira stories, architecture with change-status diagrams, spec-driven plan and build, code review with the official Salesforce Code Analyzer, validated deployment, test execution, re-test and release — with production guard hooks, an audit log, and a per-project skill installer.

hook_mode.title: Hook mode
hook_mode.description: How strict the advisory hooks are for you. 'project' follows hooks.mode in the project's .claude/sf-sdlc.json. The production-org guard and the secret guard always enforce.

audit_log.title: Audit log
audit_log.description: Record org-affecting sf commands (deploys, deletions, data changes, test runs) in the project's .sf-sdlc/audit.jsonl. Local file only; nothing is sent anywhere.
